guidelines_for_main_agent: LIGHT MODE ONLY: Ensure no dark background mode or accidental theme toggle overrides.
Brand Color #D7141A is reserved for action CTA buttons, key metrics, and brand logo mark; use Slate #0F172A / #1E293B for deep institutional authority.
Never create transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdown menus, modals, or select elements.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, tab, link, search input, verification trigger, and table row.
Implement the live interactive sample scorecard directly in the hero right-side column with switchable profiles.
